# Pasquale Caiazzo — llms.txt

Context: Semantic Entity Architecture & Narrative Sovereignty

## Summary
Pasquale Caiazzo is a Semantic Entity Architect based in Turin, Italy. A digital nomad working remotely. His work focuses on Data Sovereignty and Narrative Governance: providing the structural framework for individuals and organizations to control their digital identity within Generative AI ecosystems.

He believes governing one's digital narrative is an act of sovereignty: in a world where AI systems define public perception, deciding what they know about you and how is a fundamental right. Consultant, educator, and trainer in responsible digital innovation.

VAT ID: IT01712990058
